sections.Profile:
The "Turf Champ" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on July 25, 1958, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs and Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing
